theme_and_archetype.domain: Kitchen Operations Dashboard / Edge Vision Labeling Tool
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Dashboards and labeling tools require authority, clarity, and function-first design. High contrast ensures operators can easily distinguish labels, statuses, and video frames.

headings.description: Bold, functional, and authoritative for dashboard headers.

body.description: Highly legible for dense UI, tabular data, and long annotation lists.

mono.description: For metrics, timestamps, coordinates, and system status indicators.

rules: Never center align dense data or standard paragraphs.
Data metrics should always use mono-spaced font or tabular nums.
Color is for function only. 95% of UI should be monochrome.
Active bounding boxes or labels should use high-contrast Accents.
The video player container should have a dark background (#0A0A0A) to reduce glare and improve contrast with the live stream.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. Hover: slight lift and shadow-sm.
surface_styles.header: Solid Background with a hard bottom border. No glassmorphism here to maintain clinical/tech look.

rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Max border radius 8px for a technical feel.

custom_elements.video_player: Embed the Ivideon iframe natively. Add custom overlay controls for bounding box drawing.
custom_elements.labeling_canvas: A relative container over the video proxy images (JPEG endpoint) for drawing coordinate boxes.
custom_elements.gallery_strip: Horizontal scroll area (ScrollArea) at the bottom for captured frames with timestamps.

rules: DO NOT overuse generic cards. Go flat, rectangular, dense.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='capture-frame-btn').
Override generic Vercel looks. Make inputs sharp, borders distinct.
Hover states on all buttons and table rows.
Focus states must have a 2px offset ring (e.g., ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2).

image_urls.description: Pexels logo placeholder for the Dashboard Brand Header
Chef in kitchen - placeholder for captured frame gallery thumbnail
Empty commercial kitchen - placeholder for base stream view when offline

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a real-time webcam capture and labeling dashboard using React and Tailwind CSS. The stack uses .jsx/.js files, not .tsx.
Implement the layout using the 'Control Room' grid: a main area for the Ivideon stream/capture canvas, and a side panel for the COCO-SSD auto-detection labels and manual zone entry.
Use the provided Ivideon embed URL for the live view, and the JPEG preview endpoint to proxy/capture static frames for labeling.
Place a gallery of timestamped captured frames below or to the side of the main workspace.
Integrate the label/zone coordinates into a schema suitable for saving to a backend (mock the saving process).
Apply Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) rules: strict grid, minimal border-radius, monochromatic base with functional accent colors for bounding boxes/labels.
Ensure ALL interactive elements include descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-labels-btn').
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for the dense dashboard iconography.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Setup 'Chivo' (headings), 'IBM Plex Sans' (body), and 'JetBrains Mono' (data).
